misprints.note: No accent on the ending and no breathing on the article in the print.
The genitive ending is printed without its ι. Elsewhere on the page it is printed 'ἔρις, ιδος'.

uncertain.note: The article is broken type and looks like 'ι' with a breathing; ὁ is the obvious reading.
The final ς is broken in the print.
The diacritic over ι is small. It looks like a smooth breathing; the old OCR read it as εἶ.
The ι may have dropped out of the forme. The print shows only 'δος'.
